data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A–stage AI & Software company founded by Chad Rigetti, Idalia Friedson, and Michael Keiser, with $139M in total capital raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private firms including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI—all operating in the same sector and stage band.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $139M raised as a proxy for current post-money value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, yields $278M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI). The wide dispersion reflects material variance in capital deployment and market positioning within the frontier AI cohort.

Triangulating across both methods, the analysis supports a valuation range of $236M (conservative, stage-progression floor) to $6.4B (peer-derived ceiling), with a median of $2.9B. Key uncertainties include revenue traction and unit economics not evident in the provided data, the appropriateness of the peer median given the $2.0B–$29.0B range, and whether Sygaldry's technology differentiation and capital efficiency justify positioning toward the higher versus lower end of the range.
